tool.name: write_file
tool.description: Write or update content in a file on the system

when_to_use.trigger: User asks to create a new file
User asks to edit or modify a file
User asks to save configuration changes
User asks to add content to a file

parameters.param: Absolute or relative path to the file to write
Content to write to the file
Create .bak backup before modifying existing files

safety_rules.rule: Never write to system-critical files without explicit confirmation
Never overwrite files in /boot, /usr, /lib without sudo confirmation
Always create backup before modifying existing files
Validate content syntax before writing config files
Show diff of changes before applying
Refuse to write files larger than 10MB without confirmation
Suggest version control for important file changes

tool.output_format: Returns: { "success": boolean, "path": string, // Resolved absolute path "bytes_written": integer, "backup_path": string, // Path to backup if created "diff": string // Summary of changes (if modifying) }
